Careers at Harbor Robotics

Harbor Robotics builds autonomous cranes and yard trucks for container ports. Our software runs on machines that move steel boxes weighing up to forty tonnes, so we care a great deal about safety, testing and calm, careful engineering.

Teams are small and cross-functional. A typical team has five to eight people: robotics engineers, a product manager, a technical program manager and field engineers who spend time at the ports with our customers. Teams own their systems from design to deployment.

How we hire

Our interview process starts with a thirty-minute call with a recruiter. Next comes a technical or functional screen with someone from the team you would join. The final round is a virtual onsite of four interviews, including a behavioral interview with the hiring manager and a cross-functional conversation with a partner team.

We aim to give every candidate a decision within two weeks of the final round.
